description: Crossref works search (public REST API, no key): DOI, title, type, container (journal or book), year, authors and link for matching scholarly records. Metadata only; abstracts are not always present in Crossref. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
